title: Induction of different human enteroendocrine cells in intestinal organoids
protocol: Establishment of organoid culture
Cut intestinal tissue into small pieces using two scalpels.
Transfer tissue fragments into a 15 ml falcon tube containing 2 ml of Advanced DMEM/F12 supplemented with Y-27632 (10 µM), Collagenase type 2 (1 mg/ml), and Hyaluronidase (10 µg/ml).
Incubate for 30 minutes at 37°C in a shaker.
Check dissociated tissue under a microscope for crypt isolation. If no or few crypts are observed, extend the incubation by another 30 minutes.
Add 8 ml of ice-cold Advanced DMEM/F12 and spin the fragments for 5 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 10 ml of ice-cold Advanced DMEM/F12. If large fragments remain, filter the solution through a 70 or 100 µm strainer into a fresh 15 ml falcon tube.
Quantify crypts in 50 µl of medium to estimate the total number of fragments.
Spin the fragments for 5 min at 4°C and aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in a mixture of Basement membrane extract (BME) and Advanced DMEM/F12.
Dissolve larger pellets initially in Advanced DMEM/F12 due to BME viscosity.
Dilute BME to 60% using Advanced DMEM/F12.
Plate approximately 150-300 fragments/crypts per BME droplet of 15 µl into a suspension plate.
Allow the BME to polymerize for at least 20 minutes at 37°C.
Add warmed human intestinal organoids as described previously.
Expand human intestinal organoids and passage them as described previously.
Refresh medium every third day during expansion.
Passage organoids 1:4-1:8 per week, depending on tissue regional identity.
Initiate differentiation of human intestinal organoids 2 to 5 days post passaging when organoids are between 100-200 µm in diameter.
Plate 150-300 organoids in 15 µl BME for differentiation.
Remove expansion medium and wash each well with 1-2 ml of Advanced DMEM/F12.
Add warmed differentiation medium to each well.
Withdraw Wnt, Prostaglandin E2, Nicotinamide, SB 202190, and A83-01 from the expansion medium for differentiation medium preparation.
Add DAPT (10 µM) and PD0325901 (500 nM for duodenal, 1 µM for ileal organoids) to the differentiation medium.
For villus enriched hormones induction, add BMP-4 (20 ng/ml) and remove Noggin from the differentiation medium.
Refresh the medium at day 1 and day 3 after differentiation initiation.
Observe EECs after 3-4 days of differentiation.
Maintain organoids up to 6 days for optimal balance between cell survival and differentiation.
